Pharmacokinetic Drug-Drug Interaction between Cilostazol and Rosuvastatin in Healthy Participants. However, no reports exist on the pharmacokinetic interactions between these two drugs in healthy adults. results.text: Impact of rosuvastatin on pulse-wave velocity in men with HIV at moderate cardiovascular risk. This single-centre substudy of a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial aimed to determine the effect of 96 weeks of rosuvastatin on pulse wave velocity (PWV) in men (n = 55, 54 years) with HIV at moderate cardiovascular risk (Framingham risk score 10-15%).
